Vehicle model · Large van

Vauxhall Movano graphics and wraps

High roofs and long wheelbases give you more space for large lettering. Share photos of the actual side and rear panels before approving the layout.

Send the model year, wheelbase and photos from both sides and the rear. That gives us a starting point for the proof and helps us spot any existing accessories or damage.

Graphics options for the Vauxhall Movano

Signwriting

Cut vinyl lettering for your name, services and contact details, laid out around the Vauxhall Movano doors, handles and panel lines. Our published fitted price for a large van starts from £285.

Partial wrap

Printed panels or colour over selected areas of the Vauxhall Movano, usually the rear half or lower sides, using the paint as part of the design.

Full wrap

Printed imagery or a colour change across most of the Vauxhall Movano, including the bonnet, doors and bumpers where the film can be fitted cleanly.

Planning your Vauxhall Movano layout

Every large van has its own panel shapes, so we plan the layout on your exact model rather than a generic template. We check where the sliding door gap, handles, swage lines, rear glazing and any roof racks fall, then place your name and phone number where they stay readable from the pavement and in traffic.

If you are not sure what suits your Vauxhall Movano, try the free Van Designer or send us photos of both sides and the rear and we will suggest a layout with a fitted price.

Before & after your graphics

Prep and protect your Vauxhall Movano.

Our sister business Auto Opulence offers valeting, polishing and ceramic coating in Norwich. Add it to your booking and your Vauxhall Movano arrives ready for graphics and leaves protected.

Before fitting

Decontamination wash

A deep clean, including a clay bar treatment, removes the road film and wax that stop vinyl bonding properly to your Vauxhall Movano.

Machine polish

Tired, dull paint can be machine polished before signwriting or a partial wrap, so the paint left on show looks as good as the new graphics.

After fitting

Ceramic coating

Protect the painted panels around your graphics with a long-lasting ceramic coating that makes washing quicker and keeps the gloss.

Regular hand wash

Gentle hand washing that is safe for vinyl, so your graphics and paint stay clean without brushes or harsh chemicals.

Add vehicle care to my quote ↗See Auto Opulence services ↗Washing from £30 · Valeting from £40 · Polishing from £295, prices from Auto Opulence.

Vehicle damaged?

We can organise panel repairs.

Graphics look their best on straight, sound panels, and vinyl cannot hide dents or rust. If your Vauxhall Movano needs some bodywork first, we can organise panel repairs as part of the service, so it comes back repaired and branded in one go.

  • Dents, scrapes and scuffed panels
  • Rust spots and chipped paint
  • Damaged bumpers and trims
Ask for details and a quote ↗Send photos of the damage with your enquiry and we will include the repair in your quote.

Before you book

Vauxhall Movano graphics and wraps: your questions.

How much does signwriting cost on a Vauxhall Movano?

Signwriting on a large van starts from £285 fitted, using our published packages. Wraps are quoted per vehicle once we know the coverage and artwork.

Can you wrap a leased Vauxhall Movano?

Usually, with your lease company’s agreement. We use removable cast film and can remove the graphics before the vehicle goes back.

What do you need to quote for my Vauxhall Movano?

The model year, wheelbase and roof height, photos of both sides and the rear, your logo and the wording you want on the van.

Get a free quote

What are you driving?

Tell us the make and model, how many vehicles you have and the look you’re after. If you have photos or artwork, have them handy.
